notes.meaning: God calls on his faithful people to celebrate him with joy. When people who love God and live rightly praise him, it is fitting and beautiful. Those who have experienced God's mercy have every reason to honor him sincerely.

Worshipers are invited to praise the Lord with musical instruments, including the harp and a ten-stringed lute. Making music in public worship brings believers together to express their thankfulness to God.

differ.view: Musical instruments belonged to the ceremonial worship of the Old Testament temple and have no place in Christian worship today.

other.label: Catholic
other.view: Church music and instruments help stir devotion in faint-hearted souls, while the ten strings can symbolize keeping the Ten Commandments in love.

notes.meaning: The singer calls for new songs to celebrate fresh mercies, rather than simply repeating old routines. Music offered to God should be played with care, skill, and genuine joy.
Everything the Lord says and commands is completely fair, true, and good. All of his actions in guiding the world match his promises, proving that he is entirely dependable.
The Lord loves justice and doing what is right. His faithful love fills the entire earth, offering goodness and care to all of his creation.

God created the heavens and the vast host of stars simply by speaking his command. He needed no raw materials or difficult labor, bringing all things into existence out of nothing by the breath of his mouth.

other.label: Modern scholarship
other.view: The verse poetically describes God's powerful spoken command in creation rather than an early awareness of the Trinity or a personal Word.

notes.meaning: God gathers the vast waters of the ocean and holds them within set borders. He keeps the deep waters safely stored as if in a storehouse, keeping the land safe from being flooded.
Every person on earth is summoned to show deep respect and holy reverence toward the Creator. Recognizing his almighty power in creation should cause everyone to honor him.
The universe came into being the moment God spoke the word. His command caused all things to stand firm and continue by his sustaining power.
Nations often make clever plans against God and his people, but the Lord brings their plots to nothing. No human ruler can succeed when trying to fight against what God has decided.
Human ideas quickly fade, but God's eternal plans stand unbroken through every generation. Whatever the Lord determines in his heart will surely come to pass.
A nation is truly blessed and secure when the Lord is its God. The Lord chose Israel to be his special possession, and this happiness belongs to all who are chosen to be his people.
From his heavenly throne, the Lord looks down and watches over every person on earth. No one is hidden from his view, and he knows everything happening in the world.
God is the Maker of every human heart and spirit. Because he formed each person, he fully understands all their inner thoughts, desires, and actions.
A king is not saved in battle by the sheer size of his army, nor is a warrior rescued by physical strength. Human military might cannot guarantee safety without the Lord's help.
Warhorses were prized for their speed and battle strength, but depending on them for safety is a false hope. Military weapons and powerful animals will fail if God does not grant deliverance.
The Lord keeps a caring and watchful eye on those who revere him and rely on his faithful love. He protects them from deadly harm and provides what they need to survive seasons of famine.
Believers place their full confidence in the Lord as they wait for his rescue. He acts as their personal helper and protects them like a shield in times of trouble.
God's people experience deep inner gladness because their faith is anchored in who he is. Trusting in his holy character and promises brings real joy to the heart.
The psalm ends with a humble prayer asking for God's unfailing love to rest on his people. They do not claim any merit of their own, but simply rest their hope in him.
